## Development

Enter the reproducible Nix environment with direnv:

```bash
direnv allow
```

Or run `nix develop` manually. The shell provides the project tooling, installs JavaScript dependencies when needed, and links the project skills from `.agents/skills` into `.claude/skills`.

```bash
pnpm dev -- --open
pnpm check
pnpm test
pnpm build
```

For test ownership, browser verification and adding browser regression tests, see
the [project testing skill](.agents/skills/ryoppippi-com-testing/SKILL.md).

For framework ownership and the upstream adoption record, see
the [Ox Content integration boundary](docs/ox-content.md).
